key_terms: A point-in-time set of hard links to a table's SSTables created by nodetool snapshot. It lives on the same disk and is not an off-site backup.
Loading SSTable files from a snapshot into a table with a compatible schema, as the project does in an owned restore target.
Writes a coordinator stores for a temporarily unavailable replica and replays when it returns. It does not cover indefinite outages.
A persistent container volume that keeps a node's state across process replacement but shares the failure domain of its host disk.
Independently checking the schema, version and exact rows after a restore, since a backup is unproven until its restore has been exercised.
evidence: Actual native ARM64 Cassandra 5.0.9 CQL and retained-state observations; RF3 outage and table-level SSTable restore have independent acceptance receipts. Commands run only in the copied owned Docker project.
